evidence: Loader commit bumps pyproject.toml to 0.2.4 immediately before the locked PyPI wheel upload.
The loader build workflow clones espeak-ng tag 1.52.0, resolved to the recorded commit; the installed locked Windows DLL reports 1.52.0 via espeak_Info.
build.sh and .github/workflows/build.yml describe the shared library and dictionary/voice data builds; .github/workflows/pypi.yml and hatch_build.py describe wheel assembly.

Original upstream packaging downloaded native/data release assets through a mutable latest URL. The release ships the immutable source commits and original recipes, records the actual locked DLL hash, and does not claim a byte-reproducible native build.
Windows DLL imports only Windows APIs and the separately licensed Microsoft Visual C++ runtime, with no additional eSpeak third-party native DLLs.
